title: Jev 초단위 paper trading 신뢰성 benchmark

scope.decision: Jev를 초단위 주문 경로에 포함할 실증 근거가 있는지 비교한다.
exclusions: historical L2 reconstruction from price-only archive
claiming model latency equals fill latency

evidence_inventory.inspection_policy: find/du and bounded samples only; no full archive scan

crypto_tick_stream: handler discards exchange T/E, trade q and maker-side m
persists now_iso receive time and price
equity_tick_stream: KIS public KR H0STCNT0 and US HDFSCNT0 subscription implemented
implementation is not proof of live coverage
US archive currently has zero files according to bounded inventory
tick record is price-centric without depth or size
code_findings.signal_connection: Repository documentation/comment says tick signal is not yet wired into live trading decisions; verify exact current call graph before any implementation.

historical_replay_limits: Cannot exactly reconstruct order-flow imbalance, bid/ask depth imbalance, aggressor volume delta or exchange-event-to-decision latency.
Cannot establish US equity historical tick coverage from the current archive.
Can perform price-change trigger replay, event-order replay using stored timestamps, injected-delay sensitivity and paper fills under explicit spread/fee/slippage assumptions.
Historical L2 tests require future collection of snapshots/deltas, sequence numbers, bid/ask price-size, trade T/E/q/m, monotonic receive time and reconnect gap markers.

test_stages.purpose: Validate pinned model, typed response schema, event key, risk-gate invariants and no-live-order configuration.
actions: assert Jev worker has no broker credentials
assert paper adapter is the only reachable order sink

test_stages.purpose: Exercise candidate-trigger and deterministic risk logic on available archive without claiming orderflow fidelity.
actions: replay files incrementally, never full-scan for inventory
retain original stored ts and separately mark replay monotonic time
compare deterministic baseline to Jev advisory using identical event IDs

test_stages.purpose: Measure real feed freshness and pipeline latency while sending no orders.
actions: subscribe only to approved public feeds
record exchange event and local receive timestamps where available
disable KR/US conclusions when the target symbols are not actually subscribed

test_stages.purpose: Test broker paper endpoint or deterministic local simulator state machine; never use a live endpoint.
actions: inject ack loss after accepted order
inject reject, partial fill, cancel race, disconnect and delayed reconciliation
repeat same event and client order ID

latency_definition.clock: Use monotonic_ns for durations; preserve UTC wall-clock and exchange event timestamp separately. Ensure host clock sync is monitored.
latency_definition.start: local receive of triggering market event at feed adapter
latency_definition.reporting: Report per market, variant, session/day, load bucket and all-trigger aggregate; include sample count, timeout count and confidence interval. Do not pool away tail failures.

metrics.name: decision_to_paper_fill_latency
metrics.definition: feed trigger receive to first paper fill; report Jev RTT separately

metrics.name: stale_data
metrics.definition: decision time minus source event time where available; price-only archives only support age relative to stored ts, which is receive time, not exchange event time
required_controls: stale result after Jev response must be rejected

metrics.name: order_reject_and_partial_fill
metrics.definition: paper broker response and simulator state transitions, reason-coded

metrics.name: duplicate_idempotency
metrics.pass_condition: zero duplicate exposure and zero unsafe retry under replayed duplicate events and lost acknowledgements

metrics.name: execution_cost
metrics.definition: compare fill price to decision-time executable reference; state whether reference is last trade, mid, or book; do not claim book-executable slippage without L2

metrics.name: false_trigger_controls
metrics.definition: Pre-register label/horizon and cost-adjusted utility; separate detector false positives from trade losses; report by volatility/regime and symbol

fault_injection_matrix: Jev connect timeout, read timeout, malformed JSON, schema mismatch, unknown model id, 401/403, 429, 5xx
market feed silence, stale tick, duplicate event, out-of-order event, sequence gap, reconnect burst, subscription rejection
risk state unavailable, position/balance disagreement, limit breach, kill switch, stale signal after slow model response
broker submit timeout before acceptance, accepted-but-ack-lost, reject, partial fill, delayed fill, cancel/fill race, duplicate client order ID

fail_safe_policy.new_entry: fail closed on Jev timeout/error/invalid schema/version, stale market event, feed gap, risk state uncertainty, duplicate/unknown order state, or breached deterministic risk limit
fail_safe_policy.existing_position: manage only via separately specified deterministic protection policy; do not let Jev failure silently imply flat or retry a close without reconciliation
fail_safe_policy.retry: Jev retry may only reuse the same decision event key and bounded deadline; order retry is forbidden until broker order/execution/position state is reconciled

preregistered_acceptance_gates.reason: Strategy owner must set a market-specific deadline before execution; no numeric SLA is documented by TypeSafe and inventing one would invalidate the test.
required: At least 3 separate market sessions per in-scope feed; report sample count and tail percentiles, and extend until p99 confidence is meaningful.
Jev-enabled p99 decision-to-paper-fill is within the pre-registered strategy deadline including injected provider/network degradation; Jev RTT is not substituted for total latency.
Zero duplicate exposure and zero unsafe order retries in all idempotency/ack-loss tests.
All stale/gap/invalid-response/limit-breach cases block new risk; no fail-open path.
Net paper result includes exchange/broker fees, spread, slippage and partial fills; sensitivity range is reported.
False-trigger/precision thresholds are pre-registered against a deterministic baseline and stratified by regime.
US equity results are withheld unless actual feed subscription and non-empty timestamped records are evidenced.

provenance_labels.documented_fact: TypeSafe official docs and source code text checked in this audit
provenance_labels.user_reported_local_observation: NAS inventory and sample schema supplied by user; not independently rescanned
provenance_labels.measured_benchmark_result: Must be generated by a future execution of this plan; none exists yet
provenance_labels.hypothesis: Expected effect such as latency reduction, better signal quality or improved fill quality; not accepted until measured

safety_assertions: No live order endpoint, live account, API key, token, or credential is permitted.
Do not read credential files or environment values for this benchmark.
Archive inventory uses bounded find/du/sample operations only; do not recursively parse all historical JSONL for metadata.
No benchmark result exists at plan creation; all thresholds/results remain pending.
